name: riscv
notes: The middle vertex of the C / RISC-V / BTOR2 triangle: RV64IM assembly text with a frame discipline — `fence` is the frame boundary, `ebreak` the bad location, `ecall` a7=93 the absorbing halt, `ecall` a7=1 an input read at havoc site a1 (a0 takes steps[t][str(a1)], missing 0) — so bad and depth align frame-for-frame with the c machine (one CFG node per frame) and the btor2 machine (one transition per frame), and every pair around the triangle keeps both observables exactly under the identity map. Stimulus {"steps": [{"<site>": value, ...}, ...]}. Byte-addressed little-endian memory, .data at 0x10000, 32 64-bit registers, sp = 0x7ffffff0, entry at _start / main / first instruction. A frame of 10^6 instructions without a fence is refused, never guessed at. No domain of its own: corroborated only by its pairs' squares — the pincer. Revision 2 adds vectors and controls and changes nothing else: fault injection (kernel/faults, 2026-10-03) left 38 of 100 sampled interpreter mutants unrefused by the vectors and by the squares of the three pairs around the language. Vectors 014-019 are instruction tables — 896 checks, each one RV64IM instruction or short idiom on fixed operands against the value the specification gives, a failed check halting so that the closing ebreak is reached only when every check held: the register and immediate instructions, shifts by a register and by an immediate at and beyond the width, the division family at every sign pair with the zero divisor and the overflow, the unary pseudo-instructions and lui and every branch at less, equal and greater and each way of calling and returning, and stores and loads at every width and non-zero offsets with the data directives — each check carrying the recorded testimony of the Sail model, as written and with its expected value moved (oracles/packs/languages/riscv/operators). Vector 020 pins the language's own stipulations, which no processor shares: registers start at 0 and sp at 0x7ffffff0, the first datum sits at 0x10000, unwritten memory reads 0. Four of the survivors ship as controls. 27 of the 38 now fail the vectors; of the 11 left, nine are equivalent (the overflow cases of division, which the general case already computes on unbounded integers; the fuel count on a frame that ends; a mask wider than the bytes read through it) and two remove a refusal, which a vector cannot observe. Interpreter and every earlier vector byte-identical.
